Source: http://www.marijuananews.com

Posted September 27, 2000
Analysis By Richard Cowan

Yesterday at the taping of an MTV Special -- " Choose or Lose " -- the Vice President of DEAland said of medical marijuana, " I don't agree that it's medically effective. Doctors have studied this question pretty extensively, and so far there is absolutely no evidence that it has the effect that some people say. "
See
Even The Washington Post Notices As " Gore Reverses Stance On Medical Marijuana " Getting Worse.

Of course, this contradicts the Clinton-Gore administration’s own Institute of Medicine report that in March of 1999 said, " There is no clear alternative for people suffering from chronic conditions that might be relieved by smoking marijuana, such as pain or AIDS wasting. "
See
NORML Special Bulletin -- IOM Acknowledges:
" There is no clear alternative for people suffering from chronic conditions
that might be relieved by smoking marijuana, such as pain or AIDS wasting. "
But Still Opposes Smoked Marijuana --
and
Boston Phoenix Does Great Review Of The Medical Marijuana Issue After the IOM
and links

It also ignores an enormous range of both medical evidence and expert opinion.
See
Chairman of the House of Lords Science and Technology Committee
Criticizes UK Government’s Rejection Of Report On Medical Marijuana
– 2 Articles With 2 of the Worst Prohibitionist Arguments
and
People With AIDS Benefit From – Not Harmed by Medical Marijuana in Government Approved Test. Politically Very Important – Medically Pointless.
and
17 AIDS Organizations Write Drug Czar
Urging Medical Marijuana Not Be Delayed By IOM Report;
" Terminally ill patients cannot afford to wait for years of research
to prove something they already know: Medical marijuana works. "
and
Finnish Medical Association Supports Medical Marijuana
And Says Its Negative Effects Have Been Greatly Exaggerated.

Ironically, this statement – this lie -- was in response to a questioner who said she had a family member in prison, in part for distributing marijuana to sick friends. I say that this was ironic because the word " irony " is derived from the Greek for " mocking. " If one doubts that Gore is mocking us all, reflect that this lie followed a biographical video narrated by MTV reporter Gideon Yago that cherrfully said that in the 1960s, " He listened to rock, rode a motorcycle, and even smoked the herb. "
See
Drudge Report Makes DRCNet’s Story About Gore’s Marijuana Use Its Headline After Newsweek Delays Publication of Excerpt From Biography

To add to the absurdity of this, Gore has made his support for a so-called " Patient's Bill of Rights " a major part of his campaign. Gore’s web site quotes him as saying " There's an emergency in America, all right, and it's the lack of a strong, enforceable Patients' Bill of Rights. "
See
http://www.algore2000.com/briefingroom/releases/pr_083100_none_none_12.html

Earlier this month, Gore said, " It's time to take the medical decisions away from the health maintenance organizations and insurance companies and give them back to the doctors, the nurses and the health care professionals.''But if " the doctors, the nurses and the health care professionals'' believe that medical marijuana is best for the patient, that is another matter.

Obviously, for Gore, patients’ rights do not include the most basic right to choose a medicine that works for them. In August, the Clinton-Gore administration successfully sought from the Supreme Court an emergency stay of the distribution of medical marijuana even specifically for patients who will suffer " imminent harm " and who have " no reasonable alternative " to medical marijuana.
See
Supreme Court Grants Emergency Stay Against Oakland CBC. Arbitrary Power Trumps Basic Rights.

In addition, the Clinton-Gore administration has even tried – unsuccessfully -- to censor the private conversations between doctors and patients about medical marijuana.
See
Federal Judge Stops Drug Czar’s Threat To Pull Licenses of Doctors Who Recommend Medical Marijuana.

Gore is also promising a new program to cover prescription drug costs for some of the tens of millions of DEAland citizens who do not have health insurance. During the last eight years of the Clinton-Gore administration many poor people have had no alternative to medical marijuana, other than to suffer.
See
Costs keeping 'rescue' drugs from patients

The only real surprise in Gore’s statement is his absolute commitment to the party line in front of an audience that is even more likely to be in favor of medical marijuana than the general public.
See
Gallup Poll Shows 73% Favor Medical Marijuana;
29% Favor Outright " Legalization "!
So What Are The Politicians Really Afraid Of?

Let me be very clear about this. I have said repeatedly that the suppression of medical marijuana is murder. Gore has blood on his hands.
See
The Murder of Peter McWilliams -- An Indictment, Not an Obituary – by Richard Cowan

In November, most of the voters of DEAland will choose between " the lesser of two evils " -- and this is not a figure of speech, but a stark reality. A few will vote for either Ralph Nader or Harry Browne, but the next President of DEAland will continue to follow the prohibitionist party line until the people and the media demand otherwise. Nader is the only one who can challenge Gore on this and get any media coverage.
See
Ralph Nader Joins New Mexico Governor Gary Johnson In Calling for Legalizing Marijuana. But Can Nader Bring the Left With Him? Analysis by Richard Cowan

I urge everyone to email the Nader campaign at campaign@votenader.org and urge him to make an issue of Gore's heartless lie.

It would also be appropriate to email the Gore campaign at townhall@algore2000.com and let them know what you think.

Watch what happens over the next few days to see if any of the media challenge Gore’s absurd and insulting lie. If to witness a crime in silence is to commit it, there will be many bloody hands.
